annotations.title: Can I get the difference back?

description: Can I get the difference back? For requests like "I bought a TV at Best Buy 9 days ago for $499 and it's $449 now, can I get the difference?". Says whether a claim is likely (likely, likely_if_member, unlikely, check or no_drop), the amount, and the steps. With an item name it adds a Cheapest Price link and Amazon and eBay links to check today's price. Likely claims also get claim_message, ready to paste into the store's chat or email. policy.refund_paid_as flags stores that pay store credit (Newegg)

country.description: Two-letter country code. GB (or UK) gives the UK policy where the store has one (Apple, Amazon, IKEA) and UK rules; it also picks the price links (US, GB and IE get local Amazon and eBay links). Default from the request.

days_since_purchase.description: Days since you bought it (or since delivery), 0 to 400. Give this or purchase_date.

item.description: Optional item name, up to 100 characters, to link today's price on Cheapest Price, Amazon and eBay.

now.description: Today's price, 0 to 100000 (US dollars, or pounds for UK stores).

paid.description: What you paid, 0 to 100000 (US dollars, or pounds for UK stores).

purchase_date.description: The date you bought it, YYYY-MM-DD, instead of days_since_purchase. Adds deadlines: the last day to claim with the store (and in a members' longer window) and Capital One card protection.
